blocks.text: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme launched on 24 February 2019 by the Government of India under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare. Its primary objective is to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring agricultural inputs such as seeds, fertilizers, and equipment, and to support their domestic and allied activity requirements. It is one of the world's largest Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) initiatives, having disbursed over Rs. 3 lakh crore to more than 11 crore farmers since inception.

items: Annual benefit: Rs. 6,000 per eligible farmer family per year
Payment mode: Three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 each, credited directly to the registered bank account via DBT
Installment periods: April-July, August-November, December-March
Indian citizen engaged in agricultural activity with cultivable land in their name as per state/UT land records
All landholding farmers regardless of the size of their land holding are eligible
A farmer family is defined as husband, wife, and minor children who collectively own cultivable land
Benefit is extended to one family unit, not to individual members separately
Income tax payers: Anyone who paid income tax in the last assessment year

Government employees: Serving or retired officers/employees of Central/State Government Ministries, PSEs, autonomous institutions (exception: Multi Tasking Staff, Class IV/Group D employees are eligible)
High-income pensioners: Superannuated/retired pensioners receiving monthly pension of Rs. 10,000 or more
Constitutional post holders: Former or present Ministers, Members of Parliament, MLAs, Mayors
Professionals: Registered Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects
Institutional landholders
Visit pmkisan.gov.in
Scroll to 'Farmers Corner' and click 'New Farmer Registration'
Select 'Rural Farmer Registration' or 'Urban Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar number, select state from dropdown, enter captcha, click 'Search'
Fill in name, bank details, address, IFSC code, land details
Submit the form
Download the PMKISAN app from Google Play Store
Choose language, click 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar number, fill registration form, submit
Visit Common Service Centres (CSCs)
Contact Revenue Officials or designated state/district authorities

blocks.text: All beneficiaries must complete electronic KYC via OTP-based, biometric, or face authentication. Payments are processed only from Aadhaar-seeded databases.

items: Aadhaar Card (mandatory for e-KYC and DBT)
Land records/Khasra-Khatauni (as per state land records)
Bank account passbook (account must be Aadhaar-linked)
Caste certificate if applicable
Visit pmkisan.gov.in
Click 'Beneficiary Status' in the main menu
Enter registered Aadhaar number, mobile number, or account number
Click 'Get Data' to view payment dates, installment numbers, and transaction IDs
